Only 5 pairs are a real repeated named entity: Peter Thiel; Downtown Arcadia Improvement Association; Jackson Moses; Katherine Boyle with a16z American Dynamism; Pallas Ventures with Morpheus Space. risk: The public page reports 308 trails and 302 estate-to-estate overlaps, nearly all structural bookkeeping; it reads like findings and inflates apparent progress. Methodology itself says shared sources and custody prove nothing.
why: Keep the 35 original leads and the 5 repeated-entity pairs; the other 273 are generated.
